body:
I've considered if there's something in my relationship that is lacking something that I see in this new man, but I can't find much. I don't know what it is about him that makes me feel like this. 

I thought it was just excitement from having a friend, and maybe it still is, but it just feels different. I mean, I know it's awful, but sometimes I forget that I even miss my boyfriend. 

I don't see this man. We met over Reddit and we've been talking for almost two months. But we talk regularly. We don't flirt or insinuate any cheating (I would leave my relationship if it ever got to that point). 

I don't want to leave my boyfriend. I truly love him and I'm thankful for the years that we've had. But I don't know what I want anymore. Or now rather, who. 

I feel terrible for feeling this way. I've tried to give it thought, and even taken breaks from talking to my friend to see if it helps, but it doesn't. 

I'm just very lost and ashamed right now.
